task.title: exlcude not behaving as expected for multidoc yaml
task.body:
### Description

I'm honestly not sure if that's a bug or a feature request, but here it goes:

I use diffyml as a library to compare planned changes to the current live state of resources in k8s. (basically `heml diff` but for an internal system).
Target state is represented as a multidoc yaml, current state too.

The live state includes a bunch of lifecycle annotations, labels,  ... that I wold like to exclude from the diff output, but the filtering does not quite work for multidoc yaml


### Input YAML

`from.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: example/v1
kind: Kind1
metadata:
  annotations: {}
  labels:
    whatever: value
  name: foo
---
apiVersion: example/v1
kind: Kind2
metadata:
  annotations: {}
  subresources:
    example: 2
  labels:
    foo: bar
    quix: qux
  name: foo
spec:
  bar: baz
---
apiVersion: example/v1
kind: Kind3
metadata:
  annotations: {}
  name: foo
spec:
  bar: baz
```

`to.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: example/v1
kind: Kind1
metadata:
  name: foo
---
apiVersion: example/v1
kind: Kind2
metadata:
  name: foo
spec:
  bar: baz
---
apiVersion: example/v1
kind: Kind3
metadata:
  name: foo
spec:
  bar: baz

```

### Command and flags

```bash
diffyml --exclude 'metadata.labels.whatever' --exclude 'metadata.annotations' --detect-kubernetes from.yaml to.yaml
```

### Actual output

```text
Found six differences

metadata  (example/v1/Kind1/foo)
  - two map entries removed:
    annotations: {}
    labels:
      whatever: value

metadata  (example/v1/Kind2/foo)
  - three map entries removed:
    annotations: {}
    subresources:
      example: 2
    labels:
      foo: bar
      quix: qux

metadata  (example/v1/Kind3/foo)
  - one map entry removed:
    annotations: {}
```

### Expected output

```text
Found two differences

metadata  (example/v1/Kind2/foo)
  - two map entries removed:
    subresources:
      example: 2
    labels:
      foo: bar
      quix: qux
```

### Output format

detailed (default)

### Input characteristics

- [x] Multi-document YAML (multiple `---` separated documents)
- [x] Kubernetes manifests
- [ ] YAML anchors/aliases
- [ ] Remote URL input
- [ ] Large files (>1000 lines)
- [ ] Directory comparison
- [ ] Config file (.diffyml.yml) in use

### diffyml version

diffyml version 1.7.0 (commit: 9ead239ef12b6e6fb74d6b525cb5b79b4feb43e3, built: 2026-06-21T01:06:11Z)

### OS / Architecture

macOS 26.5.1 arm64
